notes: Product 9P26FDCWV1GC, package ReluxWorksLLC.PulsarBarycenter. Exact build before submission: {{VERSION}}, git {{GIT_COMMIT}}, MSIX SHA-256 {{PACKAGE_SHA256}}. Required server: https://barycenter.relux.works; availability owner Ivan Oparin. Primary A1 path: (1) launch Pulsar; (2) choose Try locally and play the built-in cue; (3) choose Create, then Create a Barycenter; (4) press Record, accept the expected Windows microphone prompt, record and stop a short clip (if denied, choose a short audio file instead); (5) select This Pulsar and send with Overlay or After current; (6) open History and inspect the played receipt, then the available report/block/delete controls. No Spotify account, Telegram account or demo credentials are required. Spotify and Telegram are optional. 10.3.1: the primary path has no conventional login and the six steps above expose every required feature. 10.1.1.3: the EN/RU descriptions match this build and each locale has six real exact-build screenshots of distinct primary functions; onboarding is not used as primary proof.
